question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "**delighted**".
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Displeased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"delighted"** means feeling or showing great pleasure, happiness, or satisfaction. (प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** She was delighted to receive a surprise gift on her birthday.
 
 
• The word **"displeased"** is the opposite of "delighted" and refers to feeling annoyed or dissatisfied. (असंतुष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** He was displeased with the delay in the delivery of his order.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"delighted"** is **"displeased"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Displeased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elated** (उत्साहित): Extremely happy or joyful.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt elated after winning the competition.
 
 
 
• **Jubilant** (प्रफुल्लित): Feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph.
 
 
• **Example:** The team was jubilant after their victory in the finals.
 
 
 
• **Overjoyed** (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): Feeling great joy or happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** He was overjoyed to see his family after a long time.
